submission_method.quote: All proposals shall be submitted electronically through the City's e-procurement portal, BidExpress, at https://bidexpress.northfieldcity.gov. Proposals submitted by email, fax, or hard copy will not be accepted.

contract_term.quote: The initial contract term shall be three (3) years from the date of award, with two (2) optional one-year renewal periods exercisable at the sole discretion of the City.

scope_of_deliverables.quote: The selected vendor shall provide a cloud-hosted enterprise document management system serving approximately 1,200 City staff across 14 departments, including document capture and OCR, records retention scheduling, full-text search, workflow routing for approvals, and migration of approximately 4.2 million existing documents from the City's legacy Documentum repository.
scope_of_deliverables.value: Cloud-hosted enterprise document management system for ~1,200 staff across 14 departments, including document capture and OCR, records retention scheduling, full-text search, workflow routing for approvals, and migration of ~4.2 million documents from the legacy Documentum repository.

mandatory_submission_requirements.quote: Each proposal must include all of the following. Proposals missing any item will be deemed non-responsive: a) Completed and signed Proposal Cover Sheet (Attachment A) b) Completed Pricing Schedule (Attachment C) in a separate sealed file c) Signed Non-Collusion Affidavit (Attachment D) d) Certificate of Insurance evidencing the coverages required in Section 5 e) Three (3) client references on Attachment E f) Technical proposal not exceeding forty (40) pages, excluding attachments
value: Completed and signed Proposal Cover Sheet (Attachment A)
Completed Pricing Schedule (Attachment C) in a separate sealed file
Certificate of Insurance evidencing the coverages required in Section 5
Three (3) client references on Attachment E
Technical proposal not exceeding forty (40) pages, excluding attachments

mandatory_technical_requirements.quote: The proposed solution must: a) Support single sign-on via SAML 2.0 and SCIM user provisioning b) Provide role-based access control at the folder and document level c) Retain a complete, immutable audit trail of all document access events d) Support bulk import of at least 500,000 documents per 24-hour period e) Provide a documented REST API for integration with the City's ERP
value: Support single sign-on via SAML 2.0 and SCIM user provisioning
Provide role-based access control at the folder and document level
Retain a complete, immutable audit trail of all document access events
Support bulk import of at least 500,000 documents per 24-hour period
Provide a documented REST API for integration with the City's ERP

evaluation_criteria.quote:
Technical Solution and Functionality .................... 35 points
    Vendor Experience and Qualifications .................... 20 points
    Implementation Approach and Project Plan ................ 15 points
    Cost Proposal ........................................... 20 points
    References and Past Performance ......................... 10 points
                                                             ----------
    TOTAL                                                    100 points

pricing_structure.quote: Pricing shall be submitted on Attachment C only, as a firm fixed price for the initial three-year term, with separately stated pricing for each optional renewal year. Implementation and migration services shall be priced separately from recurring subscription fees.
pricing_structure.value: Pricing submitted on Attachment C only, as a firm fixed price for the initial three-year term, with separately stated pricing for each optional renewal year. Implementation and migration services shall be priced separately from recurring subscription fees.

insurance_requirements.quote:
Commercial General Liability ........ $2,000,000 per occurrence
Professional Liability (E&O) ........ $1,000,000 per claim
Cyber Liability ..................... $5,000,000 aggregate
Workers' Compensation ............... as required by Minnesota statute

vendor_experience_required.quote: Proposers must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience implementing enterprise document management systems for public sector clients of comparable size, and must have completed at least two (2) such implementations within the past thirty-six (36) months.
vendor_experience_required.value: Minimum five (5) years of experience implementing enterprise document management systems for public sector clients of comparable size, plus at least two (2) such implementations completed within the past thirty-six (36) months.

references_required.quote: Three (3) client references on Attachment E

data_security_requirements.quote:
The vendor shall maintain SOC 2 Type II certification throughout the contract term and shall provide its most recent audit report annually.
All data shall be encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest using AES-256.
The vendor shall notify the City of any suspected data breach within twenty-four (24) hours of discovery.
value: Maintain SOC 2 Type II certification throughout the contract term and provide the most recent audit report annually
Encrypt all data in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher and at rest using AES-256
Notify the City of any suspected data breach within twenty-four (24) hours of discovery

vendor_demonstration_required.quote: The City reserves the right to invite up to three (3) finalist vendors to deliver an on-site product demonstration. Demonstrations, if requested, will be held during the week of April 6, 2026.
